summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a tempdir, chmod +x's it, and invokes the freshly downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js` (727,680 bytes, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc). `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated single-line bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift routine, `_0x...` identifier naming, 1000+ element mixed numeric/string array) and is not present in `src/`, does not correspond to any feature of the advertised React chat UI, and has no connection to the package's declared purpose. The package name uses the `@servicetitan` scope but the shipped content pattern (alternate-runtime dropper + opaque obfuscated payload executed at install) does not match a legitimate chat-UI library. Executing an opaque 727KB obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded runtime at `npm install` time runs attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
